metric_definitions.minimum_usable_capacity: Minimum initial usable storage C for which every time step of the frozen trace can be met under storage_next=min(C,storage+admitted_inflow)-delivered_demand, with overflow recorded separately.
metric_definitions.gross_installed_volume: Minimum usable capacity + dead volume + freeboard + measurement uncertainty allowance + contingency allowance; all components stay separately reported.
metric_definitions.admitted_inflow: Raw source inflow is credited only when both intended-use quality and source metrology are admitted for the same circuit/use profile and timebase; otherwise credited inflow is exactly zero and raw inflow is reported as rejected.
metric_definitions.pump_power: P_hydraulic = rho*g*(Q_m3_h/3600)*TDH; electrical lower bound = P_hydraulic/eta only if 0 < eta <= 1 and efficiency evidence is admitted.

rules: Demand, storage, source and use profile identities must match.
Timebase identities and trace array lengths must match exactly.
Negative/non-finite demand or inflow is rejected and never clipped to zero.
Quality-unadmitted or measurement-unadmitted inflow is excluded from capacity credit and reported as rejected.
Tank dead volume, freeboard, uncertainty and contingency are not usable reserve and are reported separately.
Storage sizing assumes the usable inventory is full at the beginning of the declared design horizon; any other initial condition requires its own explicit input and benchmark.
Source inflow is added at the beginning of each declared time step before that step's demand; the convention is frozen in the manifest.
Pump power is a lower-bound arithmetic calculation, not pump selection or duty qualification.
time_step_convention: For every step: add admitted source inflow, cap at usable capacity and record overflow, then serve that step's demand from remaining storage. Initial usable inventory equals the tested capacity.
